mapper.update: INSERT INTO MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG (NAME) VALUES (#{name}) ON CONFLICT(NAME) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT h.NAME FROM MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG h INNER JOIN MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG_RECORD r ON r.TAG_NO = h.TAG_NO WHERE r.FRAGMENT_NO = #{fragment_no} ORDER BY h.NAME
SELECT EMOTION AS emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM MB_FRAGMENT_EMOTION_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND TARGET_TYPE = 1 AND TARGET_NO = #{fragment_no} GROUP BY EMOTION

SELECT EMOTION AS emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM MB_FRAGMENT_EMOTION_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND TARGET_TYPE = #{req.targetType, typeHandler=com.utime.memoBom.board.typeHandler.EEmotionTargetTypeHandler} AND TARGET_NO = GROUP BY EMOTION

SELECT
f.FRAGMENT_NO AS fragment_no, f.UID AS fragment_uid, f.CONTENT AS content, DATETIME(f.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT,
u.UID AS user_uid, u.NICKNAME AS user_nickname, u.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS user_img_url,
t.UID AS topic_uid, t.NAME AS topic_name, t.OWNER_NO AS topic_ownerNo, t.COLOR AS topic_color, t.IMOGI AS topic_imogi, t.EMOJI_SET_TYPE AS emoji_set_type,
CASE WHEN s.USER_NO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
0
AS is_scrap,
img.UID AS img_uid, img.ORIGINAL_NAME AS img_original_name, img.WIDTH AS img_width, img.HEIGHT AS img_height
FROM MB_FRAGMENT f INNER JOIN MB_USER u ON f.USER_NO = u.USER_NO INNER JOIN MB_TOPIC t ON f.TOPIC_NO = t.TOPIC_NO
LEFT JOIN MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP s ON s.FRAGMENT_NO = f.FRAGMENT_NO AND s.USER_NO = #{user.userNo}
LEFT JOIN MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE img ON img.FRAGMENT_NO = f.FRAGMENT_NO AND img.IMAGE_ORDER = 0 WHERE 1=1 -- 기본 조건 AND f.IS_DELETED = 0 AND u.ENABLED = 1 AND t.ENABLED = 1
-- ✅ 얘깃거리 공개/비공개 접근 조건 AND ( t.EXTERNAL = 1
OR ( t.EXTERNAL = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MB_TOPIC_FOLLOW tf WHERE tf.TOPIC_NO = t.TOPIC_NO AND tf.USER_NO = #{user.userNo} ) )
)
AND u.UID = #{req.userUid}
AND t.UID = #{req.topicUid}
AND f.UID = #{req.fragUid}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS c WHERE c.FRAGMENT_NO = f.FRAGMENT_NO AND c.IS_DELETED = 0 AND c.UID = #{req.cmtUid} )
AND ( f.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{req.keyword} || '%' OR t.NAME_UPPER LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{req.keyword}) || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG_RECORD r INNER JOIN MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG h ON h.TAG_NO = r.TAG_NO WHERE r.FRAGMENT_NO = f.FRAGMENT_NO AND h.NAME = #{req.hashtag} )
ORDER BY f.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 5 OFFSET (#{req.pageNo} - 1) * 5

SELECT
f.FRAGMENT_NO AS fragment_no, f.UID AS fragment_uid, f.CONTENT AS content, DATETIME(f.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT,
u.UID AS user_uid, u.NICKNAME AS user_nickname, u.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS user_img_url,
t.UID AS topic_uid, t.NAME AS topic_name, t.COLOR AS topic_color, t.IMOGI AS topic_imogi, t.EMOJI_SET_TYPE AS emoji_set_type,
img.UID AS img_uid
FROM MB_FRAGMENT f INNER JOIN MB_USER u ON f.USER_NO = u.USER_NO INNER JOIN MB_TOPIC t ON f.TOPIC_NO = t.TOPIC_NO
LEFT JOIN MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE img ON img.FRAGMENT_NO = f.FRAGMENT_NO AND img.IMAGE_ORDER = 0 WHERE 1=1 AND f.IS_DELETED = 0 AND u.ENABLED = 1 AND t.ENABLED = 1
AND f.UID = #{fUid}
AND f.FRAGMENT_NO = #{fNo} ;
SELECT CASE COUNT(1) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS RES FROM MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP WHERE 1=1 AND USER_NO = #{userNo} AND FRAGMENT_NO = ( SELECT FRAGMENT_NO FROM MB_FRAGMENT WHERE UID = #{fUid} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP ( USER_NO, FRAGMENT_NO ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, (SELECT FRAGMENT_NO FROM MB_FRAGMENT WHERE UID = #{fUid}) )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO MB_FRAGMENT_EMOTION_LOG ( USER_NO , TARGET_TYPE , TARGET_NO , EMOTION , UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userNo} , #{req.targetType, typeHandler=com.utime.memoBom.board.typeHandler.EEmotionTargetTypeHandler} , , #{req.emotion, typeHandler=com.utime.memoBom.board.typeHandler.EmotionCodeTypeHandler} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT(USER_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO) DO UPDATE SET EMOTION = excluded.EMOTION, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT EMOTION AS emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM MB_FRAGMENT_EMOTION_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND TARGET_TYPE = 2 AND TARGET_NO = #{comment_no} GROUP BY EMOTION

SELECT c.COMMENT_NO AS comment_no, c.UID AS comment_uid, c.CONTENT AS content, DATETIME(c.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT,
u.UID AS user_uid, u.NICKNAME AS user_nickname, u.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS user_img_url FROM MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS c INNER JOIN MB_USER u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE 1=1 AND c.COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo} AND c.IS_DELETED = 0 AND u.ENABLED = 1

SELECT c.COMMENT_NO AS comment_no, c.UID AS comment_uid, c.CONTENT AS content, DATETIME(c.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT,
u.UID AS user_uid, u.NICKNAME AS user_nickname, u.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS user_img_url FROM MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS c INNER JOIN MB_USER u ON c.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE 1=1 AND c.IS_DELETED = 0 AND u.ENABLED = 1 AND c.FRAGMENT_NO = ( SELECT FRAGMENT_NO FROM MB_FRAGMENT WHERE UID = #{uid} ) ORDER BY c.COMMENT_NO DESC LIMIT 7 OFFSET (#{pageNo} - 1) * 7

SELECT F.UID AS fragment_uid, DATETIME(F.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT, F.CONTENT AS content,
T.UID AS topic_uid, T.NAME AS topic_name, T.COLOR AS topic_color, T.IMOGI AS topic_imogi, T.EMOJI_SET_TYPE AS emoji_set_type FROM MB_FRAGMENT F JOIN MB_TOPIC T ON T.TOPIC_NO = F.TOPIC_NO WHERE 1=1 AND F.IS_DELETED = 0 AND F.USER_NO = #{user.userNo}
AND F.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, F.FRAGMENT_NO DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{pageNo} - 1) * 10

SELECT C.UID AS comment_uid, C.CONTENT AS content, DATETIME(C.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT,
T.UID AS topic_uid, T.NAME AS topic_name, T.COLOR AS topic_color, T.IMOGI AS topic_imogi, T.EMOJI_SET_TYPE AS emoji_set_type,
F.UID AS fragment_uid,
CASE WHEN LENGTH(F.CONTENT) > 10 THEN SUBSTR(F.CONTENT, 1, 10) || '...' ELSE F.CONTENT END AS fragment_preview FROM MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS C JOIN MB_FRAGMENT F ON F.FRAGMENT_NO = C.FRAGMENT_NO JOIN MB_TOPIC T ON T.TOPIC_NO = F.TOPIC_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND C.USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND F.IS_DELETED = 0 AND C.IS_DELETED = 0 AND T.ENABLED = 1
AND C.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC, C.COMMENT_NO DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{pageNo} - 1) * 10

SELECT F.UID AS fragment_uid, DATETIME(F.CREATED_AT, 'localtime') AS CREATED_AT, F.CONTENT AS content,
T.UID AS topic_uid, T.NAME AS topic_name, T.COLOR AS topic_color, T.IMOGI AS topic_imogi, T.EMOJI_SET_TYPE AS emoji_set_type
FROM MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP S JOIN MB_FRAGMENT F ON F.FRAGMENT_NO = S.FRAGMENT_NO JOIN MB_TOPIC T ON T.TOPIC_NO = F.TOPIC_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND S.USER_NO = #{user.userNo} AND F.IS_DELETED = 0 AND T.ENABLED = 1
AND F.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY S.CREATED_AT DESC, S.FRAGMENT_NO DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{pageNo} - 1) * 10
SELECT UID AS "uid" , MIME_TYPE AS "mimeType" , STORAGE_NAME AS "storageName" , ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originName" , WIDTH AS "width" , HEIGHT AS "height" FROM MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE WHERE UID = #{uid}
